purpose: Teach: 盛り込ま/所定/同月/両側/過大/前々/附属/米ドル

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、報告書に新事実を盛り込まれますね
lines.en: So the police include new evidence in their reports, then.
lines.style: Measured, affirmative tone. Slight lifting inflection at the end—acknowledging rather than questioning. Speaking at the steady pace of someone reading from a list. Businesslike but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、所定の書式を遵守されますね
lines.en: And they follow the prescribed format for documentation, right.
lines.style: Same measured rhythm, continuing down the checklist. A touch of quiet confirmation in the voice. No doubt, just noting the procedure. Even delivery, shoulders relaxed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、同月内の犯罪統計を公表されますね
lines.en: They release crime statistics for the month too, I understand.
lines.style: Steady, almost conversational now but still grounded. Light acknowledgment at 'I understand'—not seeking confirmation, just narrating what is. Breath flows naturally through the statement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、現場の両側を封鎖されますね
lines.en: And they cordon off both sides of the scene, of course.
lines.style: Continuing the rhythm. The 'of course' sits naturally—not condescending, just the expected procedure. Voice stays level. A slight pause before the last phrase, like turning a page.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、過大な憶測は避けられますね
lines.en: They avoid speculation and overreach in their statements, naturally.
lines.style: Still in the list, but a touch more weight on this one. Slight emphasis on 'avoid'—this matters more than form-filling. Voice stays low, the conviction quiet but present. Steady pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、前々から要警戒の人物を追われますね
lines.en: They pursue suspects they've had under watch for some time.
lines.style: A shift now—firmer ground. The voice gains a thread of certainty. Slight lean forward in the delivery. The tone tightens just a fraction, no longer just naming procedure but naming action. Same measured pace but with muscle underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、大学附属病院と医療連携されますね
lines.en: They coordinate with the university hospital for medical information.
lines.style: Back to steady. The weight lifts slightly again. Acknowledging the coordination matter-of-factly. Voice returns to that level checklist tone. Slight breath before the final phrase.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、米ドル偽札の捜査もされますね
lines.en: And they're also investigating the counterfeit US currency case, aren't they.
lines.style: Final item, delivered with a slight pull of knowing—this ties threads together. Tone closes with quiet certainty. The 'aren't they' lands softly, not a question but an anchor. Voice settles lower at the very end, like the last piece fitting.
